eyebrow: A little clarity. A better chapter.
headline: Stay inside the story.
intro: Characters you remember. Names that stay consistent. Story Lens brings a little order to the worlds you love reading.
passageBefore: Mira reached the archive before dawn. Across the bridge,
passageAfter: held the last lantern. “The city remembers every name,” he said. Behind them, Orin opened the silver gate — and the story began again.
caption: Your chapter, with a little more context.
noteBody: Keeper of the map. An ally from the northern coast.
whyIntro: A hundred names. A new translation. A week between chapters. A good story deserves your attention, without the extra detective work.
featureIntro: Keep your place in the cast, smooth out a translation, and read the way that works for you.
featureCards: Give names a color, connect aliases, and keep notes and versions close with tooltips.
Turn inconsistent translated names into the ones you recognize.
Recognize supported novel pages with per-site selectors and optional AI-assisted detection.
Open the popup in your reading tab, move the launcher, and pick text directly from the page.
Download novel reference data, queue supported edits, and sync when you reconnect.
Pair the desktop companion to summarize a page through your own Claude Code or Codex login.
demoTitle: See the names. Follow the thread.
demoIntro: An original miniature story. Switch on the tools and watch the same passage become easier to follow.
demoStatus: The sample passage has been updated.
demoNote: Illustrative demo; no page content is sent anywhere.
steps: Install Story Lens from the Chrome Web Store.
On a supported novel site, the lens appears beside the page.
Find or add character information, use available replacements, and keep reading.
companionTitle: A recap, through your own AI account.
companionBody: The companion runs on your computer and calls your installed Claude Code or Codex CLI. The selected provider receives the page content you ask to summarize. Story Lens’s API is not part of this summary path.
downloadNote: macOS and Windows build instructions are available. Published installers are not available yet; local builds may be unsigned.
pairing: Connect in the extension’s AI tab
privacyPoints: Summaries start when you click; your chosen AI provider receives the page content.
AI-assisted chapter detection sends the page URL and HTML through the API to OpenRouter.
Downloaded reference data and extension preferences live on your device.
This website has no analytics or advertising scripts.
questions: Sites with configured chapter selectors support automatic novel detection. The text picker and AI tab can also work on ordinary web pages; browser-internal pages are excluded.
The API supports guest and registered accounts. Permission to edit shared data depends on your role.
Downloaded novel reference data remains available offline. Supported local edits queue for synchronization; new server requests and AI features need a connection.

Chapter-selector detection uses OpenRouter through the backend. Page summaries use your own installed Claude Code or Codex CLI through the optional companion. Provider charges and limits depend on your account.
Yes. The extension and this website support English and Arabic, including right-to-left layout.
The source includes Firefox builds. A published Firefox listing has not been verified, so we currently link to Chrome and the source repository.
The source is available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Commercial use requires separate permission.
You can install the extension from its store listing. AI provider charges and usage limits are separate. We do not promise permanent pricing or availability.
finalTitle: Let the story take it from here.
finalBody: A familiar cast. A clearer chapter. A little lens for your next read.
footerTag: Clarity for the worlds you read.
notFoundBody: The page you’re looking for could not be found.
